title: Donruss #699 George Canale Milwaukee Brewers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1990 Donruss #699 George Canale rookie trading card featuring the player from the Milwaukee Brewers. This original baseball card is a 3½" x 2½" size, part of the Donruss set, and is a highly collectible item for fans of vintage sports trading cards. The card showcases George Canale as a rookie player for the Milwaukee Brewers during the 1990 season, making it a valuable addition to any baseball card collection.
